name: Datalastic
description:
Find vessels by name, IMO, MMSI, call sign, flag, type, dimensions, or other identifiers. Access live and historical positions, track multiple ships, reconstruct movements, find vessels within an area, and estimate positions outside terrestrial tracking coverage.

Explore ship particulars, ownership and management, maritime companies, ports and terminals, engines and propulsion, classification, inspections, detentions, deficiencies, casualties, dry-dock and survey dates, certificates, and vessel sale, purchase, and demolition records and more. 

Key capabilities include:

• Live, bulk, and historical vessel tracking

• Vessel search by IMO, MMSI, name, call sign, flag, type, dimensions, and tonnage

• Historical AIS tracks and vessel movement reconstruction

• Vessels within an area, around a port, or near another vessel

• Estimated positions outside terrestrial AIS coverage

• Ship particulars, capacity, build details, and technical specifications

• Vessel ownership, beneficial owners, operators, managers, and P&I clubs

• Maritime company profiles and contact information

• Port and terminal search, details, operators, and locations

• Port State Control inspections, detentions, deficiencies, and inspection history

• Casualties, incidents, classification, surveys, and certificate dates

• Engine, propulsion, dry-dock, and vessel history information

• Vessel sales, purchases, demolitions, buyers, sellers, and reported prices

• Sea-route calculation and distance analysis between ports or coordinates

• Bulk vessel, port, historical traffic, and maritime intelligence reports

_published_faq.name: How do I add Datalastic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Datalastic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.datalastic.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Datalastic MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Datalastic lists 26 MCP tools, including disconnect, find_ports, find_vessels, get_port, get_vessel, get_vessel_history, get_vessel_info, get_vessel_pro, get_vessels_bulk, get_vessels_in_radius, get_weather, and intel_info.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Datalastic?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Datalastic in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Datalastic requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Datalastic is developed by Datalastic. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
